text:
maria: FYI support ticket: permalinks to headings don't jump when the sidebar group is collapsed. Tried `/docs/guide#using-the-cache` and nothing happened.

raj: weird. I can repro locally. The DOM id is present but the page doesn't scroll when the group is closed. Hashchange gets handled but expansion happens asynchronously and scroll is lost.

kevin: can you paste the failing URL?

maria: https://docs.redwood.inference.dev/docs/guide#using-the-cache

kevin: minimal repro in console:
```
// when sidebar group collapsed
window.location.hash = '#using-the-cache'
// expected: scroll, actual: no-op
```

kevin: opened branch `fix/sidebar-hash-expand` — plan: intercept hashchange, expand sidebar group first, then call a microtask to run `document.getElementById(hash)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'auto'})`. Add small debounce so repeated hash changes don't thrash.

sophia: nice. please add unit/integration tests so linkcheck doesn't keep flapping on preview deploys.

kevin: added `expandAndScroll(hash)` + unit test. Also had to import the client handler in the static build entry so deploy-preview includes it.

maria: while poking around I found a page with an indented heading that generated `streaming-1` id. Quick fix: added explicit header ID in `docs/examples/streaming.md`: `### Streaming example {#streaming}`. We should call this out in a migration note for MkDocs->Docusaurus quirks.

raj: can we detect duplicate/generated id collisions at CI time? I remember a broken anchor once caused multiple 404s.

kevin: added a lightweight script `scripts/find-duplicate-ids.js` that scans rendered markdown for repeated ids and fails. Usage: `node scripts/find-duplicate-ids.js docs/`. It currently emits file:line where duplicates occur.

sophia: policy: fail on duplicates for `main` and `v2` branches, warn elsewhere. That should prevent regressions without slowing feature branches.

docsbot: linkcheck job (deploy-preview #4121) reported: 
```
WARN Link check: /docs/guide -> #using-the-cache (client-side nav failed)
```
kevin: addressed the race by awaiting a tick after expanding. Replaced setTimeout with `await Promise.resolve()` helper to avoid flaky timers. Also ensured we clear any pending expand timeouts on unmount.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview #4121 updated 
Staging: https://deploy-preview-4121--docs.redwood.inference.dev/docs/guide#using-the-cache

raj: tested in staging, permalink expands sidebar and scrolls reliably now. :tada:

kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1499 (ready for review). Diff: sidebar client handler, expandAndScroll tests, `scripts/find-duplicate-ids.js`, docs migration note about explicit header ids.

sophia: i'll backport to `v2` after merge and include a short changelog entry: "Docs: fix deep-link scrolling when sidebar groups are collapsed; add CI duplicate-id guard."

maria: i'll update the support ticket and ping the customer. Also added a brief note in `docs/migration/mkdocs-to-docusaurus.md` about common anchor pitfalls and the `{#id}` workaround.

kevin: merged main -> will open backport PR to `v2`. Thanks for the quick reviews.

maria: resolved here, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
